## Description

Employs regularized Vine Copulas (R-vine copulas) to model complex high-dimensional non-linear dependency structures across multi-factor equity models, preventing tail dependency breakdown.

## Where it may fit

Multi-factor equity portfolio construction, non-linear asset co-movements during macro crises.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Equity Funds, Systematic Factor Investing Desks.

## Required data

Multivariate factor return series, cross-sectional stock rankings, fundamental factor panels.

## Caveats

Tree structure selection in Vine copulas is computationally intensive for large factor dimensions.
